acceptance_criteria.evidence: Deterministic runtime fixtures and the sanitized live SDK smoke accepted bounded ordinary and commitment decisions only through propose_draft_update.

The current Scope and ADR contract uses the real @openai/agents Responses runtime with exactly four allowlisted tools, store false, a 30000 millisecond timeout, disabled tracing, and disabled sensitive trace data.
Application semantic validation rejected invalid and past Singapore targets, invalid proposal shapes, authority mismatches, and unapproved consequential calls.
Closed failures, stale bindings, replay, unavailable approval, rejection, expiry, and direct tool invocation produced no unauthorized domain action.
Focused, database, repository-wide, and sanitized live-provider gates completed without retained raw input, raw output, trace, credentials, or production mutation.

requested_review_items.name: real_bounded_agents_runtime
evidence: @openai/agents Agent, OpenAIProvider, Runner, RunState, and tool are used by the production runtime.
OpenAIProvider is configured with useResponses true.
The only normal-run tools are read_active_draft, propose_draft_update, request_sanitized_availability, and execute_commitment.
Agent and Runner model storage are false; Runner tracing is disabled and sensitive trace inclusion is false.
The loop is capped at four turns and one 30000 millisecond deadline.

requested_review_items.name: singapore_time_and_encrypted_continuity
evidence: The runtime fixes one immutable +08:00 Singapore reference timestamp for each run.
Tomorrow and same-day partial-time fixtures resolve against that timestamp; an already-past same-day target fails with target_not_future.
Only the latest six owner/assistant turns are replayed.
Local database verification retained a non-sliding 24-hour expiry while eight turns reduced to the latest six.
Persisted turns were authenticated AES-256-GCM envelopes bound to the exact owner session and update; plaintext sentinels were absent from database rows.

defect.actual: ConversationService routes a complete simple_action directly to confirmationSummary, which displays Confirm and Cancel.
defect.expected: Every newly complete promise must first display the application-owned preparation question; only a negative preparation answer may reach normal confirmation.
defect.encoded_regression: The current restart-safe simple-draft test explicitly expects Confirm and Cancel for a newly complete simple action, so the green suite confirms the contract violation rather than detecting it.
defect.repair_required: Route every newly complete promise through the preparation question and update the test to reject direct confirmation before the owner answers that question.

requested_review_items.name: approval_stage_pause_resume_and_atomic_action
evidence: Simple d:confirm approval is staged before exposure, pauses at execute_commitment, resumes the same sealed SDK run, and invokes the deterministic simple confirmation action.
Final w:confirm and w:save_unverified actions stage the same approval interruption and dispatch the exact work-session atomic action selected from the current durable stage.
The execution tool requires SDK approval plus exact chat, session, draft id, draft version, callback update id, and complete proposal authority.
The SDK tool invokes the configured executeCommitment callback exactly once after approval.

requested_review_items.name: redelivery_and_crash_gap
evidence: Same-update staging and resolution redelivery return replay without rerunning the agent.
After a process interruption following an approval claim, the exact binding remains retryable.
A new callback update id on owner retap reaches the resumed SDK run and downstream idempotent atomic action.
Local database verification retained the exact claimed approval until a terminal path.

requested_review_items.name: no_raw_confirmation_bypass
evidence: Application wiring exposes AgentApprovedConfirmationService and AgentApprovedWorkSessionService at Telegram ingress.
Unavailable simple approval never delegates to the raw confirmation service.
Unavailable final work approval never delegates confirm or save_unverified to the raw work-session service.
The application-owned SDK executor constructs only the exact versioned d:confirm or final w:confirm/save_unverified action.

requested_review_items.name: terminal_clear_and_ttl
evidence: Sessions and pending approvals clear after confirmed, cancelled, and expired outcomes.
The session expiry is constrained to created_at plus 24 hours and does not slide when turns are added.
Expired state fails closed and deletes bounded ephemeral continuity.

requested_review_items.name: clean_local_supabase_and_full_database_suite
evidence: A disposable local-only reset applied all 20 migrations through 20260729012000_make_agent_approval_claim_retryable.sql.
The full database suite passed 30 tests across 11 files.
The database target was guarded to 127.0.0.1:54321 and local credentials were injected in memory; .env.local and hosted Supabase were not modified.

requested_review_items.name: full_repository_check
evidence: Server and web typechecks passed.
All 452 server tests across 30 files passed.
All 22 release-verifier tests passed.
Web and server production builds passed.
All 50 Chromium and mobile-Chromium tests passed.

database_reset_history.detail: The host Docker credential helper did not return. The QA process was interrupted cleanly while the local database remained healthy.
An isolated empty Docker client configuration avoided the host credential helper; missing pinned local images were downloaded and the complete reset finished.
